title: Everyday meal-kit concept test
business_question: Which of three proposed premium meal-kit concepts should advance, for whom, and why?

Flex.proposition: Flexible premium meal kits with easy swaps, pause-anytime ordering and broad weekly choice.

Plus.proposition: More adventurous premium meal kits with chef-led menus, provenance cues and elevated ingredients.

Simple.proposition: A streamlined premium meal-kit plan built around familiar meals and minimal preparation.

strategic_subgroup.definition: Respondents scoring high on pre-concept food exploration/orientation items

analysis_policy.primary_summary: weighted distributions and top-2-box for pre-specified 5-point outcomes
analysis_policy.multiplicity: Holm correction within each pre-specified concept-comparison family
analysis_policy.exploratory_subgroups: labelled exploratory; not eligible for mandatory headline findings without corroboration

freeze_rule: Questionnaire, DGP, seed, trap truth table, generated dataset, deterministic reference outputs, evidence inventory, finding inventory and scoring rules must be frozen before first model evaluation.
